name: geo-content-os
description: GEO Content OS — 企业级 GEO 多平台内容生产系统 (MVP v1.0)

scripts.eval:all: pnpm eval:rag && pnpm eval:material-parser && pnpm eval:content-writer && pnpm eval:fact-checker && pnpm eval:topic-planner && pnpm eval:geo-optimizer && pnpm eval:quality-checker
scripts.generate:openapi: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/api exec tsx openapi/generate.ts
scripts.test:a11y: pnpm --filter web build && pnpm exec playwright test --config apps/web/test/a11y/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/testkit build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-outbox-relay build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-ai build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-publisher build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-sohu-browser build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-lieju-browser build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-douyin-browser build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:security: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-web-fetch test:security && pnpm --filter security test:security && pnpm --filter api test:security && pnpm --filter web test:security
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter contracts test && pnpm --filter security test && pnpm --filter observability test && pnpm --filter testkit test && pnpm --filter worker-outbox-relay test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-knowledge test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-ai test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-sohu-browser test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-lieju-browser test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/worker-douyin-browser test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-email test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-image test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-storage test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-web-fetch test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-ocr test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-embedding test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-rerank test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-model test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-model-deepseek test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/skills test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/parsers test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/eval-rag test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/eval-material-parser test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/eval-content-writer test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/eval-fact-checker test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/eval-topic-planner test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/eval-geo-optimizer test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/eval-quality-checker test && pnpm --filter api test
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:contract && pnpm test:integration
scripts.verify:observability: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/observability test && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/observability build && node infra/observability/verify.mjs
scripts.verify:openapi: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts test -- src/api/catalog.test.ts && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/api exec tsx openapi/generate.ts --check && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/sdk build
